name: Chenda
description: A traditional cylindrical percussion instrument from Kerala, widely used in temple festivals, ceremonies, and classical performances like Kathakali and Theyyam.

sources.title: Kerala Tourism - Traditional Arts and Culture
Sangeet Natak Akademi - Percussion Instruments of India

notes: The chenda is one of the most prominent percussion instruments in Kerala. It is central to chenda melam, a traditional ensemble performed at temples and festivals. The instrument consists of a cylindrical wooden shell with cowhide membranes stretched over both ends, held together by braided cords.
